name: Watch new CISA KEV matches for your software inventory in Discord — no AI API

parameters.content:
## Start here
1. Edit **Configure inventory** using exact aliases from the KEV catalog.
2. Keep `dryRun: true`, then run **Manual preview**.
3. Select your own Discord Webhook credential in **Discord alert**.
4. Set `dryRun: false`, publish/activate. First live run establishes a quiet baseline.
5. Later new matches are sent daily; only successful delivery advances state.

A vendor/product match is an exposure candidate, not proof of affected software/version. No AI/API subscription required. Configure the workflow time zone. Use only one active copy.

## Persistence and delivery
Workflow static data persists only after successful production executions; manual tests/CLI do not demonstrate durable scheduled state.

Historical KEVs are suppressed at first live baseline. Review the preview before enabling. Changing inventory resets the baseline. Keep Continue On Fail off. Partial delivery failure can resend earlier parts next time (at least once). Avoid overlapping executions. Missing credentials/feed failure must appear as failed executions; configure an error workflow in your instance.

CISA due dates describe federal remediation deadlines; they are not a finding of your organization’s obligations.
